    Class TpChess

    The custom <tp-chess> element displays chess positions and plays out endgames.

    Example

    <tp-chess position="8/8/3k4/8/3PK3/8/8/8" draggable-pieces=""></tp-chess>

    Tagname

    tp-chess

    Attr

    position = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR" - Piece placement or full FEN. Placement-only input defaults to White to move with no castling or en-passant rights.

    Attr

    fen = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1" - Full six-field FEN, synchronized after every move. Takes precedence over position on initial connection.

    Attr

    orientation = "white" - Side displayed at the bottom of the board.

    Attr

    draggable-pieces = false - Enables human moves by dragging, clicking or keyboard. Also accepts the HTML spelling draggablePieces; the JavaScript property is draggablePieces.

    Attr

    draggablepieces = false - HTML-normalized alias of draggablePieces; use draggable-pieces for the canonical markup spelling. tp-chess-change Emitted after an accepted position change or legal move.

    Eventdetail

    tp-chess-change { fen: string; position: string } tp-chess-move Emitted after a legal move, including castling, en passant and promotion.

    Eventdetail

    tp-chess-move { from: string; to: string; san: string; promotion?: string; fen: string } tp-chess-end Emitted after a move ends the game by checkmate or a draw.

    Eventdetail

    tp-chess-end { fen: string; result: string } tp-chess-error Emitted when a supplied position or play configuration is invalid; the previous position is preserved.

    Eventdetail

    tp-chess-error { message: string }

    Keyboard

    Arrow keys Move focus across the board in the displayed direction.

    Keyboard

    Enter / Space Select a piece or move it to the focused square.

    Keyboard

    Escape Cancel the selection, drag or promotion choice.

    Accessibility

    Squares have coordinate and piece labels, a roving keyboard focus and visible legal-move indicators. Game status is announced politely.
